mentions.name: Pantry Recipes
mentions.description: This iOS mobile app generates recipe ideas based on the ingredients users already have at home. Users save or quickly select on-hand ingredients and tap Generate Recipes to get instant ideas, or describe a dish free-form (e.g., cheese omelette) to have the app generate a recipe. It is free for a number of recipe generations, with a low-cost subscription for unlimited use, and is live on the iOS App Store.
